copy.curiosityHook: As screens permeate every home, both teenagers and adults face how online personas alter who they are behind closed doors.
copy.description: Directed by Jason Reitman, this comedy-drama tracks a group of high school students and their parents as the internet reshapes their daily communication, self-image, and romantic lives.
copy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful and emotionally grounded; an unhurried, observant ensemble drama suited for solitary or family viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Reitman examines modern digital intimacy with a steady, thoughtful balance of domestic comedy and emotional consequence across multiple generations.

allowedMaterial: Ensemble of high school teenagers and their parents
